beats.text: The US and China are courting allies in the AI race.
Washington may ask dozens of nations to pick a side.
Countries cooperating with China could lose access to US tech coalitions.
Beijing pushes back, demanding digital sovereignty for every nation.
AI competition is now a geopolitical showdown.
Europe punches above its weight in AI research.
Lagarde highlights Europe’s struggle to turn science into business.
beats.quote: One of the main problems is Europe's difficulty turning scientific excellence into commercial success, partly because its markets and financing remain too fragmented.

beats.text: Euro‑area firms plan to spend about 9% of investment on AI by 2026.
